intro.text: The eldest son of Rivershore's reeve, Matin, and his wife Rema: an eager, warm-hearted boy whose disability has kept his mind from maturing.

items.text: In the life December lived before waking in the past, Jamek was eight when his mother died. It hit him hardest of the brothers, since he needed a loving parent and his father was busy being reeve. He was seventeen when Matin married December, and her kindness helped him so much that he was soon always at her side. Like his younger brothers, he groaned whenever she called him cute. The plague killed him in the end.
